payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CLEAR approach shows better generalizability when transferred from the RXR dataset to the R2R dataset, suggesting that zero-shot transfer is feasible.

claims.text: The CLEAR approach demonstrates better generalizability when transferred to the Room-to-Room (R2R) dataset from the Room-Across-Room (RxR) dataset.
Empirical results indicate that the CLEAR method outperforms the baseline in success rate and nDTW score when applied to the R2R dataset.
